confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from automated SQL injection attempts to a successful account takeover, privilege escalation, massive database querying, large-scale data exfiltration via DNS and HTTPS, and finally an attempt to cover tracks by deleting authentication logs.

attack_chain.description: Automated SQL injection attempts using sqlmap targeting the web server API.
Successful login of user_07 from an unusual IP (104.244.76.13) during off-hours.
Unauthorized privilege escalation where user_07 was elevated to 'dba' status.
Massive database queries targeting the 'customers' table, affecting hundreds of thousands of rows.
Data exfiltration via DNS tunneling (UDP port 53) to a known malicious domain.
Large-scale data exfiltration via HTTPS (TCP port 443) totaling approximately 217 MB.
Attempt to cover tracks by deleting the system authentication log (/var/log/auth.log).

gaps: Verification of whether user_07's credentials were stolen via the initial SQL injection or a separate method.
Confirmation of the exact contents of the exfiltrated data.
narrative: An attacker used SQL injection to likely compromise credentials or exploit the system, subsequently logging in as user_07 from an external IP. The attacker escalated privileges to DBA, queried massive amounts of customer data, exfiltrated the data through DNS and HTTPS, and then deleted authentication logs to hide the intrusion.
